verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm with an O-1 practice page and a startups practice, so a structured O-1A qualification assessment is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack documents no process for evaluating a founder's extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before filing. The O-1 page excerpt covers only O-3 dependent eligibility, and the Visalaw AI items describe generic drafting and research tools, not a documented qualification assessment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed
